prompt:

The flange size and style must EXACTLY match the straight pipe in the provided reference image so the openings line up when connected. The tube curves in a smooth quarter-circle arc between the two openings; the bottom-left area of the cell is empty transparent space.

The pipe art sits on a fully TRANSPARENT background (no metal backplate, no square tile). Art style: match the provided reference exactly — glossy glass tube, polished brass ring flanges with rivets, glowing electric-blue water with bubbles and highlights, clean industrial steampunk game UI art. Keep the pipe perfectly identical and aligned in all 8 cells; ONLY the water changes.
